scope: bounded local recovery center, deleted-resource edit recovery, guarded deletion and portable draft bundles
checks: two exact source/base bundle round trips retain BOM/CRLF/64-bit numeric tokens and unfinished JSON; invalid locations/fields/duplicates refuse before import; differing existing drafts are skipped

actual bounded cursor stops at entry/source admission without deleting records; actual draft/version and shared-view guards preserve changed copies, atomic quota abort rolls back imports and ordered writes settle before management
controlled recovery dialog selects exact bundle/source downloads, requires explicit recovery, and cancelled listing/file reads cannot populate or replace a successor dialog

actual app recovery opens invalid unfinished source for an absent file without writing, retains original base/undo and marks recreation review, preserves an existing newer buffer, and refuses cancelled/stale reads
limits: Two tiny drafts and controlled Node IndexedDB/modal/editor hosts only. Draft snapshots are limited to 128 entries / 16 MiB counted source with explicit incomplete listings; individual source/base strings admit 8 MiB UTF-8; bundles admit 32 MiB / 2048 structural nodes. Invalid or oversized stored records are retained. Recovery does not write pack files; normal Save validates/reviews conflicts and absent-path recreation. Open buffers take priority. Ordinary autosave remains last-writer-wins across tabs; draft management/import guards do not establish cross-tab editor ownership. Actual browser focus/layout/IndexedDB durability/quota/multi-tab and native/client/release qualification remain pending. No native build/generation, registry/state sweep, GPU work, broad suite or GitHub workflow.
